    NOTICE: We are aware of some problems which users may be experiencing when accessing this site using Microsoft Edge. This is under investigation, however users can still access papers on the site with alternative web browsers.

    Welcome to the Sunderland City Council Committee Management System, CMIS.  

    Here you will be able to find out about the various committees that the Council manages and the Councillors who represent you. You will be able to find out who sits on which committees, any decisions or declarations they have made, examine agendas and minutes of any meeting and find out how to contact any member of the Council. You may also examine the Members' Register of Interests and the Council's Forward Plan. 

    Under the "Outside Bodies" on the "Committees" pages you will also be able to inspect Agendas, Minutes and Reports relating to some outside bodies for which the City Council is the Lead Authority, such as the Tyne and Wear Fire and Rescue Authority.
     
    An archive of meetings from 1999 to 2008 is also available by clicking here
